dedupe_keys.name: multi hazard ncei storm event sets cleaned noaa storm events database and compound event sets

description: This dataset provides cleaned versions of the NOAA NCEI Storm Events Database for 1950 to 2024 and 1996 to 2024, and six collections of hazard event sets curated from the 1996 to 2024 version to study multi-hazard and compound events in the United States. Each collection applies a different filter of impact thresholds (injuries, deaths, property and crop damage) and a temporal lag window of 10, 30 or 90 days that defines when events interact, and contains four sets: all hazard events, single-hazard only events, multi-hazard event pairs and unique multi-hazard events. It was produced by Joshua Green of the University of Southampton with Python scripts published on GitHub. Version 1.0 of 31 May 2026 is accessible on Zenodo as free downloads (six zip files of event sets and two Parquet files of the cleaned database, about 1.07 GB) under CC BY-SA 4.0. Caveats: Storm Events records depend on reporting practice that changed over time, damage estimates are approximate, and the interaction definition depends on the chosen lag and thresholds. It supports multi-hazard scenario design and hazard exposure analysis for infrastructure, and calibration of compound event models; a related record is the NOAA Storm Events Database.
